title: Your Agent Is Right 9 Times Out of 10. Now Run It 8 Times.
description:
An AI agent that works 9 times out of 10 gets all 8 of 8 runs right only about 43% of the time, and that number is arithmetic under an independence assumption, not a measurement. Real runs are correlated, which is exactly why you measure this instead of computing it. From Put AI to Work episode five.

Full episode: https://youtu.be/_FUX238WunQ
